name: Maximum Carnage, Part 9: The Turning Point
title: The Spectacular Spider-Man #202
desc: Shortly after, Morbius and Nightwatch find Carnage's hide out and Carnage gets Doppelganger and Demogoblin to fight them while he watches. Meanwhile Shriek is making people go crazy as Spider-man and the rest soon realize. Cap then stops her and Spider-man webs her to a pole. Back at the Statue of Liberty, Morbius and Nightwatch have to retreat because the sun is coming up. Carnage then gets Demogoblin and Doppelganger to go and bug there 'mom' while Carnage continues to torture Venom. Now with Shriek knocked out, Spider-man and the others convince people to stop the violence, until Demo and the Doppelganger show up and free Shriek. The previously crazed civilians show up and help fight Shriek, Demogoblin and Doppelganger. Shriek gives them a final push to attack the heroes.
